fixed: A filter you chose no longer goes on narrowing the list out of sight once no dance has that value: the Filters panel keeps it as a selected chip you can remove, even when the whole section would otherwise be hidden, and a level, author or source that has since been deleted reads Not in your library. A By phrase pick in a phrase no dance has any more keeps its row too, and an Advanced Has tag row keeps its tag instead of silently dropping it.
With the Tags filter hidden in Settings, an Untagged choice is no longer left narrowing the list out of sight: the section shows while it holds Untagged, and hiding Tags clears it.
Typing a number into a custom number filter, such as a lone minus sign or the first bound of Between, no longer clears what you typed; Clear all still empties it.

added: FacetSelections.hasSelectionFor(tags) counts Untagged, and clearFacets clears it with the Tags section. FacetSelections.clearCount counts clears (in memory only). FacetSelections.keepSelectedTags marks the selected tags a host opened with, which retainTags then keeps even while no live dance carries them; a tag picked by hand is dropped as before. CollectionPanelState.fromSavedSearch says a state was read from a saved search; SavedSearchSpec.toPanelState sets it.
